title: Power Platform delivery project configuration
description: Project facts the power-platform-delivery plugin can't discover from the repository. Stored at .agent-config/power-platform.json. Anything discoverable (solutions, projects, base branch and so on) must not be stored here.

$schema.description: Path or URI of the schema, for editor tooling.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the file was written against.

azureBoards.description: Where work items are created and queried. Omit for a project that doesn't use Azure Boards.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organisation URL (for example https://dev.azure.com/contoso) or organisation name.

areaPath.description: Area path applied to new work items unless a more specific path is given.

workItemTypes.description: Maps the plugin's work item roles to the process template's work item type names.
